# Bibek Khatiwada, SEO Strategist

> Kathmandu-based SEO strategist, open to remote work, specializing in entity-based and semantic SEO, technical SEO, content systems, SEO automation, and AI search visibility (AEO, GEO, llms.txt). 3+ years of experience with clients in 6 countries: United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Ireland, South Africa.

Case-study figures are Google Search Console data. Client names are confidential.

## Technical Frameworks
- [LLM Tracking: How to Monitor Brand Visibility, Citations, and Retrieval in AI Search](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/frameworks/llm-tracking/): A technical guide to tracking brand presence across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews using automated prompt matrices, RAG chunking, and machine-readable context.
- [The EAV (Entity-Attribute-Value) Model for Modern Search](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/frameworks/entity-attribute-value-search/): Moving beyond keyword density into knowledge graph triples. How structuring content as Entity-Attribute-Value triples establishes defensible topical authority for semantic search engines.
- [AEO & GEO: Engineering Content for LLM Extraction & AI Overviews](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/frameworks/aeo-geo-playbook/): Technical formatting, structured citations, schema grounding, and machine-readable llms.txt endpoints designed to maximize citation rate in Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and ChatGPT.
- [Anatomy of a 130,000-Page YMYL Recovery](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/frameworks/130k-page-ymyl-recovery-mechanics/): The technical mechanics behind Case 01: crawl budget consolidation, pruning 20,000 dead/duplicate URLs, building structured topic hubs, and recovering visibility across core Google updates.

## Tools Showcase
- [Content Semantic Flow Checker](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/tools/): spaCy + sentence-transformers (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) pipeline for analyzing semantic similarity, topic drift, and entity coverage between content headers and search intent.
- [n8n & Colab GSC Anomaly Detector](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/tools/): Automated workflow engine monitoring daily Google Search Console API data for unexpected click/impression drops, cannibalization flags, and SERP layout shifts.
- [Automated llms.txt & Markdown Generator](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/tools/): Static generator module that automatically parses HTML site structure and builds a standardized, clean markdown /llms.txt file for AI web crawlers.

## Industry Blueprints
- [Home Trades & Multi-Location Services](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/industries/home-services-hvac-plumbing/): HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, Roofing, and Emergency Services. Optimizing local service-area pages, GBP listings, citation consistency, and hyper-local intent.
- [B2B SaaS & Enterprise Tech](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/industries/b2b-saas/): Product-led SEO, documentation search, comparison pages, and high-intent bottom-of-funnel keyword capturing for software platforms.
- [Programmatic & Large Inventories](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/industries/programmatic-directories/): Automotive marketplaces, directory portals, real estate listings, and large e-commerce catalogs with hundreds of thousands of dynamic URLs.

## Case studies
- [Medical / YMYL health platform — recovery at scale](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/case-studies/medical-ymyl-recovery/): 21.2M clicks, 1.47B impressions, 1.4% CTR, average position 7.3 over 16 months
- [UK vehicle-scrapping service — programmatic at scale](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/case-studies/programmatic-vehicle-scrapping/): 1.12M clicks, 117M impressions, 1.0% CTR, average position 14.8 over 16 months
- [Shopify e-commerce — rendering & crawl budget](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/case-studies/shopify-rendering-crawl-budget/): 449K clicks, 40.8M impressions, 1.1% CTR, average position 8.2 over 16 months
- [Recovery and stability at scale](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/case-studies/recovery-stability-at-scale/): 60.4K clicks, 8.87M impressions, 0.7% CTR, average position 12.8 over 16 months
- [Algorithm recovery — Google broad core update](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/case-studies/broad-core-update-recovery/): 29K clicks, 2.69M impressions, 1.1% CTR, average position 9.7 over 16 months
- [Education platform — year-over-year growth](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/case-studies/education-yoy-growth/): clicks +74% year over year (36.8K vs 21.1K)
- [New SaaS platform — fast ramp, strong positions](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/case-studies/saas-fast-ramp/): 20.9K clicks, 859K impressions, 2.4% CTR, average position 6.9 over 16 months
- [New SaaS platform — organic growth from launch](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/case-studies/saas-organic-from-launch/): 14K clicks, 301K impressions, 4.7% CTR, average position 7.6 over 16 months
- [Medical research platform — topical authority](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/case-studies/medical-research-topical-authority/): 7.7K clicks, 136K impressions, 5.6% CTR, average position 15.5 over 16 months

## Services
- [Technical SEO](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/services/#technical-seo): Fix crawl, indexation, rendering, structure, and speed issues across simple sites and huge inventories.
- [Content Architecture](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/services/#content-architecture): Design topical maps and pillar-cluster systems so content earns authority instead of competing with itself.
- [Automation & Custom Tools](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/services/#automation): Turn repetitive SEO work into reliable workflows, scripts, dashboards, and internal tools that scale delivery.
- [On-page SEO](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/services/#on-page-seo): Titles, metadata, headers, internal links, URLs, schema, and search-intent alignment.
- [Off-page & Authority](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/services/#off-page-seo): Build trust beyond the page through white-hat links, digital PR, citations, and brand signals.
- [Content Writing](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/services/#content-writing): Write useful, intent-led content that is clear for readers and extractable for search systems.
- [Reporting & Analytics](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/services/#reporting): Make performance visible through dashboards, KPI systems, and decision-ready reporting.
- [AI Search & LLM Tracking](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/services/#ai-search): Monitor how brands appear across AI answers while improving their semantic and structured-data foundations.
- [Local & E-commerce SEO](https://bibek-khatiwada.com.np/services/#local-ecommerce): Grow local and commerce properties through GBP, location pages, collections, products, and Merchant Center.
